visualCharacteristics.purpose: lifestyle image with an overlaid panel listing card benefits (heading plus benefit titles and descriptions)

contentPattern.structure: image rows (picture only): first is the background, second is the side or decorative photo; first text row: panel heading; further rows: one benefit each (optional icon cell | title and description)

usage: Credit card and banking product pages, benefit highlights.
reuseGuidance: Use dark for a dark translucent panel, benefit-columns for icon benefits in columns on a wide panel, single-benefit for one heading and text, with-side-photo to place a separate photo beside the panel.
